summary: Liturgical Challenges Phase 1 — end-to-end backend + frontend test. Backend pytest 13/13 PASS (list/detail with soul-cake prep content, enroll idempotency, checkin streak + duplicate-no-double-count, my-progress, admin gating 403 for non-admin, PATCH challenge + day, publish/unpublish cycle, generate-days overwrite=false skip path). Frontend (mobile 390x844, admin session minted in Mongo + injected via window.localStorage 'sanctus_session_token'): /challenges hub renders 3 cards (challenge-card-{slug}) with toggles (challenge-toggle-{slug}); toggling ON enrolls and Home card (challenge-home-card) appears; 'Mark today complete' (challenge-home-checkin) transitions to 'Marked for today'; /challenges/hallowtide shows opening prayer and the soul cake recipe (ingredients + steps + 'soul cake' text); calendar shows cal-challenge-{date} stripes across the patched window AND the per-day cal-challenge-tile-hallowtide tile; toggling OFF correctly removes both the home card AND the calendar stripes (contract honored); Profile shows profile-admin-challenges-link for admin user. Two notable frontend issues: (1) /admin/challenges renders an empty page — no admin testIDs, no list, body text is empty. (2) /challenges/[slug] detail page does not actually expose challenge-day-checkin-{day_index} buttons in the DOM because no day is auto-expanded (likely because hallowtide currently only has 1 seeded day whose date doesn't match today even after patching the envelope). Console warnings: 'candle-outline' is not a valid Ionicons name (used for Advent track icon) and deprecated 'shadow*' / 'props.pointerEvents' RN-web style API usage.

ui_bugs.issue: Admin screen renders an empty body — neither the loading spinner area nor the 3 admin challenge rows are present in the DOM. body.innerText is empty and no [data-testid] elements are found after a 5s wait. /api/auth/me returns is_admin=true for the same token, and /api/challenges/admin/all works in pytest, so the bug is in the screen's gating/render: most likely the `if (!ready) return;` / `if (!user?.is_admin) return;` short-circuits returning nothing (no fallback markup, no header). Suggest rendering a placeholder/'loading' SafeAreaView while ready=false and a clear 'Admins only' message when user is not admin so the screen never goes blank.

Detail screen does not render any challenge-day-checkin-{day_index} buttons in the DOM. Today's day is supposed to be auto-expanded with a Mark complete button. Even though detail content (opening prayer, preparation, ingredients, steps, 'soul cake') is visible, the per-day list area appears empty / not auto-expanded. Likely root cause: hallowtide currently only has 1 seeded day whose date_str does not match 'today' even after patching the challenge envelope dates, so the auto-expand logic falls through. At minimum, the screen should still render Day 1 collapsed with a tappable testID; right now there is no per-day testID at all.

When the challenge has more days in its date window than days seeded in challenge_days, the header reads 'DAY 6 OF 1' (computed from window vs total_days from day count). Cosmetic but confusing. Either clamp dayIndex to totalDays, or display the date-window position differently when the day records haven't been generated yet.

Advent card uses Ionicons name 'candle-outline' which is NOT a valid Ionicons glyph. Console logs 'is not a valid icon name for family ionicons' three times. Pick a real Ionicons icon (e.g. 'flame-outline', 'sparkles-outline') or move to MaterialCommunityIcons (which has 'candle-outline').

issues: State pill reads 'Day 6 of 1' for the date-patched hallowtide track because total_days counts day records (1) not window length. Cosmetic only — happens because content seed has a single Day 1 row from earlier iterations.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated 'shadow*' style props on web — React Native Web 0.19+ wants boxShadow. Console warns repeatedly: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Reference: shared theme/shadow tokens used across challenge cards.
Deprecated 'props.pointerEvents' — should be style.pointerEvents on web. Console warns repeatedly across tabs.

action_items: Fix /admin/challenges blank-screen: render the SafeAreaView + header even while ready=false / user=null, and show a real 'Admins only' state for non-admins. Today the screen silently returns nothing so admins cannot reach the new UI from the Profile link.

Fix detail screen to always render at least Day 1 with a testID-bearing 'Mark complete' button. The auto-expand-today logic must not gate the per-day testID rendering — render all days (even collapsed) so testers and users can find them.
Replace 'candle-outline' Ionicons name (Advent track) with a valid one — e.g. 'flame-outline', 'star-outline', or import MaterialCommunityIcons.

Clamp ChallengeHomeCard / hub state-pill dayIndex to min(dayIndex, totalDays) OR generate the missing day records so total_days matches the window length. Currently shows 'Day 6 of 1' on patched windows / sparse seeds.
Migrate 'shadow*' StyleSheet props and `pointerEvents` prop to the new RN-web 0.19+ API (boxShadow / style.pointerEvents) to silence deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: challenges.py admin_generate_days: when an LLM call fails for a date, the failure is logged and pushed into `failures[]`, but the response still returns ok=true with a partial result. Consider 207-style status or at least include failure count in the summary so the UI can warn the admin.

challenges.py checkin: streak is recomputed by walking backward from the SUPPLIED `payload.date`, not from today. A user who back-dates a checkin (e.g. fills in yesterday) will get current_streak based on that older date — could be intentional but worth a comment.

_get_challenge_or_404 with `allow_drafts=True` on DELETE /enroll is good (lets a user unenroll from a track that was re-drafted). But POST /checkin uses `allow_drafts=False` — so unpublishing a track mid-season silently breaks checkin for already-enrolled users (400 'enroll first' is misleading; they'd actually hit 404 from _get_challenge_or_404). Consider allow_drafts=True for checkin when the user is already enrolled.

Frontend ChallengeHomeCard.tsx: `await checkinChallenge(...)` swallows errors silently with a bare catch — a network failure leaves the button stuck in the un-pressed state with no toast. Add a small error indicator.

Frontend app/admin/challenges.tsx: relies on `useAuth().ready` and `user.is_admin` but does not render a fallback screen — leads to the blank-page bug above. Always return a SafeAreaView with header + body to give users (and tests) something to anchor on.

success_rate.frontend: ≈80% (calendar + home card + hub + enroll/unenroll + detail content all pass; admin screen blank + per-day testIDs missing)

seed_data_creation: Minted one admin user (user_id=TEST_chal_ui_user_1) + session_token (TEST_chal_ui_tok_1) directly in Mongo. PATCHed hallowtide start_date/end_date to 2026-06-05 → 2026-06-20 so today (2026-06-10) falls inside the window. After UI tests, restored hallowtide dates to 2026-10-31 → 2026-11-08 and removed the test user + session + enrollments + checkins. Pytest fixtures separately mint TEST_chal_admin_* and TEST_chal_user_* and clean them up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth: insert into user_sessions/users with is_admin=true; on web preview run window.localStorage.setItem('sanctus_session_token', JSON.stringify(token)) before navigating. The challenges router runs `_seed_challenges_if_missing` on every list call so the 3 tracks always exist. To force a track 'active today', PATCH /api/challenges/admin/{slug} with start_date/end_date that bracket today, AND remember to restore them afterward. Hallowtide currently only has 1 challenge_day record in this env (from earlier iterations) — generating real days via /admin/{slug}/generate-days costs LLM credits and is slow. Two HIGH bugs remain for main agent: (1) /admin/challenges blank, (2) detail screen never exposes per-day Mark complete testIDs.
rca_of_issue: RCA #1 (admin blank screen): app/admin/challenges.tsx has `if (!ready) return; if (!user?.is_admin) return;` at the top of the function body. `return;` inside a function component returns `undefined`, which React renders as nothing. There is no loading state, no auth-failure state, no SafeAreaView fallback — so the entire screen is blank until both gates pass. On the web preview, the route mounts and the auth-context's ready flag may still be false (or user fetched after a beat) leaving the screen blank indefinitely. Fix: replace the bare returns with `return <SafeAreaView>...loading…</SafeAreaView>` and `return <SafeAreaView>...Admins only…</SafeAreaView>` respectively. RCA #2 (no per-day Mark complete testID in DOM): the seeded hallowtide track contains only a single challenge_day row (day_index=1) whose date_str does not match today even after patching the envelope. The detail screen's auto-expand-today logic falls through and apparently does not render the day list at all (only the header / opening prayer / preparation). Verify by inspecting the days[] returned by GET /api/challenges/hallowtide — if non-empty, every entry should render with testID challenge-day-{day_index} and a Mark complete button. If days[] is empty, the UI should still show an empty-state with a regenerate prompt for admins.
